evidence_sources.role: documents exact/near-exact variable names and semantics
documents 42-island design, isolation construction, fire-history context and response-selected habitat-amount scales

mechanical_header_verification.reason: Dryad safe-file download endpoint returned HTTP 401 before any safe-file byte in v0.67
mechanical_header_verification.rule: when exact safe bytes become available, every required/allowlisted field must be matched to the documented header before any data row is semantically opened; unknown or ambiguous spelling is a pre-response STOP

special_rules.buffer_1: documented but not automatically admissible to the fresh primary because the source study selected habitat-amount scales from richness-response slopes
special_rules.buffer_10: documented but not automatically admissible to the fresh primary because the source study selected habitat-amount scales from richness-response slopes
special_rules.fire.stdev: may be used only if mechanically verified and complete enough under the frozen response-blind rule; source model-selection subset must not determine inclusion

RDA_environmental_variables.csv.unknown_columns_rule: any header not prospectively classified above remains closed until a new response-independent documentation-only revision; row values must not be inspected to decide its role

island_isolation.csv.semantics: buffer5000 is proportion water in the 5-km island buffer; 1 means completely surrounded by water / stronger external isolation

time_since_fire_beetles.csv.semantics: beetle-relevant estimated years since fire; exact Island header must be mechanically verified before row access

habitat_reference_rule.pool: only prospectively allowlisted response-independent RDA habitat-structure columns
habitat_reference_rule.inclusion: columns mechanically verified and nonmissing on all 42 eligible islands; no outcome-based subset selection
habitat_reference_rule.transformation: z-standardize from safe values only, then deterministic PCA if at least 2 habitat columns survive
habitat_reference_rule.pca_rule: retain the smallest number of PCs whose cumulative variance is at least 80%; if exactly one complete habitat variable survives, use it directly
habitat_reference_rule.hard_stop: if no prospectively safe habitat-structure variable beyond area/isolation/fire history is complete on all 42 islands, STOP before biological response rather than selecting a post hoc surrogate

primary_design_requirements.response_selected_habitat_scale_rule: buffer_1/buffer_10 may not enter the fresh primary solely because the source paper selected those scales from species-richness slopes
primary_design_requirements.spatial_geometry_rule: Lat/Long only; graph scale and pilot/confirmatory split must be frozen before biological response access
primary_design_requirements.species_universe_rule: beetle species present on at least two frozen pilot islands after burned-pilot access; same fixed universe for all heldout islands

transport_state.v0_66_failure: relative URL wrapper bug before safe-file content
transport_state.v0_67_failure: resolved API download URL returned HTTP 401 before safe-file content
transport_state.resume_condition: exact safe metadata bytes become available through an independently auditable source or exact user-supplied file matching the frozen SHA-256
